content.short: IPOR builds Fusion, vault infrastructure for accessing, deploying and managing onchain strategies.
content.description: Fusion, built by IPOR, is vault infrastructure that lets managers deploy and run on-chain vaults allocating across protocols from one interface. Every vault exposes its allocations, performance, costs and on-chain activity, with transaction-level auditability for depositors. The platform states more than 500 million dollars in assets under management and MiCA authorisation, and IPOR acts as a core risk management provider for Aave. Fortune 500 companies, ETP issuers and independent curators are among its users. It is deployed on Hyperliquid, Monad and Robinhood Chain.
